address: The Galleria Al Maryah Island, Hamouda Bin Ali Al Dhaheri Street, Abu Dhabi
bio: Step inside celebrity chef Kunal Kapur’s modern take on Indian upmarket street food with an elegant twist. Located in The Galleria Mall on Al Maryah Island, this stylish restaurant boasts rich fabrics and sepia and black and white panelled walls, hinting at a subtle but stylish colonial style. Ask for a seat in one of the semi-private booths and get ready to enjoy carefully prepared dishes served by an equally delightful team.
